full_judgment: 3. Plaint case in short is that the Delni Court of Wards was owner in possession of the suit land along with other land and the record of rights was finally prepared in its name. Narendra Nath Chakraborty as manager and S. K. Delhari, as Collector transferred the suit land along with other land to Palash Chandra Dey, Monindra Mohan Deb, Anath Bondu Deb Gupta and Protap Singh with necessary permission by a deed dated 13.01.1947 and delivered possession. Said purchasers partitioned said land by a registered deed of partition dated 22.09.51. On the basis of such partition, Anath Bandu Deb Gupta got the suit land along with other land and possessed exclusively. During the revisional survey, the suit land was though recorded in RS plot No. 525 out of CR no. 268/269 and Town Survey Plot No. 184 but was omitted from the Khatian of said Math Bondu Deb Gupta. After the death of said Anath Bondu Deb Gupta, the plaintiff became owner in possession of the suit land. Defendant No. 1 Comilla Municipality made a new market on the land adjacent to the suit land and let out to different people. As the Municipality was pressing the plaintiff hard to take lease, the plaintiff was constrained to institute the suit.
